high_level_description: The image captures a moment during the opening ceremony of the 2012 London Olympics. The setting is an indoor stadium filled with spectators who are seated on tiered rows. The crowd is diverse, with many individuals holding up their phones to capture the event, suggesting a high level of engagement and excitement. In the foreground, a person dressed in an elaborate costume resembling a horsewoman is walking across the stage. The costume includes a helmet that covers the entire head, a white skirt-like garment, and metallic armor-like elements on the upper body and legs.
